component: Separator color producer and consumer chronology

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch removes five Thunderbird separator-color definitions so the imported shared style can supply its value. D252997 describes the intended historical default as currentColor with 25% opacity. Fixed accepted variables.css instead sets --panel-separator-color to --color-surface-border, and panelUI.css still consumes that token. Keep the historical rationale separate from the later producer. Reviewer platform observations do not establish a new computed-color or contrast result.
title: Historical separator-color consolidation does not fix a permanent opacity rule
